description: Explains Cofounderbase Verified (a $29 one-time payment, no subscription) and returns a secure checkout link for the user's listing. The user pays on the Dodo Payments page; never ask for or accept card details in the chat. Verified never adds award votes or changes rank. Call it when the user asks about Verified or wants to upgrade.

listing_id.description: The listing_id returned by directory_register (a UUID). Only the person who registered has it.
